text:
lina: heads-up bringing up zi-v1 (q4a) on multilingual evals. reproducible punctuation/bracket flips when Chinese and Arabic appear inline; BLEU drop on zh->ar. small repro below. :eye:

mohit: paste minimal repro + model/tokenizer details

lina: model: zi-v1 q4a-pack, tokenizer=hybrid-unified-2029. repro:

input: 我在《新品》裡看到這個（商品）然後她說: "هل هذا مُتوفر؟"
expected detok (fp16): 我在《新品》裡看到這個（商品）然後她說: "هل هذا مُتوفر؟"
q4a detok: 我在》新品《裡看到這個）商品（然後她說: "هل هذا مُتوفر؟"
# note: corner/round brackets and Chinese corner quotes swap sides and a parenthesis moved across the CJK segment

mohit: can you run tokenizer.verbose_tokens on the example and diff token ids fp16 vs q4a? specifically check if packer introduced alias ids for punctuation

ellis: also check streaming vs batch detok; streaming sometimes applies incremental bidi and can differ.

lina: quick token id diff: fp16 ids: [210,4321,110,9999,301] vs q4a ids: [210,4321,8201,9999,301]  # 8201 = pack-alias for LEFT_PAREN

mohit: alias 8201 appears in packer alias table. looks like alias lacks mirror-neutral metadata so bidi/detok treats it as mirrored next to RTL spans and flips order. probable root cause. :thinking_face:

lina: eval snapshot: zh->ar BLEU zi-v1 fp16 22.5, zi-v1 q4a 19.3 (delta -3.2). zh->en stable. run link: https://redwood-internal/eval/3233-zi-v1

ellis: plan: run two quick experiments: (A) reencode with pack disabled on a 1k mixed sample set, (B) detok tweak to treat pack-alias tokens as mirror-neutral. post diffs.

triage-bot: started job triage/bisect/3233333333  runner-7 ETA ~18m

mohit: if A recovers BLEU fully then alias->bidi interaction is root cause. short-term mitigation could be tokenizer post-normalize to expand alias punctuation to canonical codepoints near mixed-orientation spans. long-term: change packer to tag alias tokens mirror=neutral.

triage-bot: update  job running on runner-7 (9m remaining)

triage-bot: job complete. results: (A) pack disabled -> BLEU recovered to 22.3 and bracket order fixed on repro set. (B) alias neutral in detok -> partial recovery to 21.7. recommended remediation: short-term tokenizer post-normalize + add unit tests covering CJK+RTL punctuation combos; long-term packer metadata change.

lina: opening ticket ML-5320 and short-term PR for post-normalize + tests. will coordinate perf checks for detok changes and add mixed-orientation smoke to the multilingual pipeline.

mohit: thanks  once PR lands run full eval run and streaming/batch comparison. add a regression assert for the failing sample set. :thumbsup:
